events.title: Steam Next Fest Is Live! - It Came From Above Us
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is live!I’m happy to share that It Came From Above Us is taking part, and you can try the demo on Steam right now. For those who haven’t come across the game yet, It Came From Above Us is a hand drawn romance visual novel with a mysterious story and a slightly unsettling atmosphere.
